text.p: The Italian debt market closed sharply higher, boosted by other markets and underpinned by the strength of the lira against the mark and dollar.

Traders said the June Btp Liffe contract started the rally right from the opening on positive Spanish CPI data which spurred on Bonos. Markets got a further boost in the afternoon when U.S. producer prices posted an unexpected fall.
The lira firmed to a day's high against the mark at 984.20.
"If the exchange rate keeps helping the Btp rally can continue," one trader said. Some saw next resistance at 130.80.
